remediated_findings.title: GetSortedTiers silently ignores contradictory self-loop edges unlike IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder
remediated_findings.notes: Self-loop now throws InvalidOperationException from shared BuildTopologicalGraph. IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder catch and return false (preserving original behavior). GetSortedTiers does NOT catch — see RA-ALGO-001.

remediated_findings.title: Three methods contain 100% duplicated Kahn's Algorithm logic with only minor behavioral differences
remediated_findings.notes: Extracted shared BuildTopologicalGraph (UnionFind + adjacency + in-degree + rootToMembers) and TryTopologicalSort (Kahn BFS with optional uniqueness check). Three thin public wrappers. All algorithmic semantics preserved.

new_findings.title: GetSortedTiers propagates InvalidOperationException for self-loops; IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder catch and return gracefully
new_findings.rule_violated: Public API consistency — when one method in an interface returns a sentinel value for invalid input, sibling methods should not throw unhandled exceptions for the same condition
new_findings.remediation: Add try/catch in GetSortedTiers returning empty list, or document the throwing behavior in IValidationService XML doc.

new_findings.title: BuildTopologicalGraph unconditionally constructs rootToMembers even when discarded by callers
new_findings.rule_violated: Efficiency — shared utilities should not perform work that known callers will discard
new_findings.remediation: Add a bool includeRootMembers parameter (default true) to BuildTopologicalGraph; skip rootToMembers construction when false. Or accept negligible overhead for contest-scale datasets.

new_findings.title: ALGO-003 (UnionFind union-by-rank) not addressed in remediation wave
new_findings.rule_violated: Union-Find textbook optimality requires both path compression and union-by-rank
new_findings.remediation: Add _rank field and union-by-rank as specified in original ALGO-003 remediation.
